message: REINDEX without CONCURRENTLY blocks writes to the table, and reads that use the index, until the rebuild finishes.
why: VACUUM FULL and CLUSTER take an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock and write a new copy of the table. REINDEX takes a SHARE lock on the table and an exclusive lock on each index it rebuilds. The lock is held until the command finishes, which on a large table can take minutes or hours.
safeAlternative: Use REINDEX ... CONCURRENTLY, alone in its query() call, in a migration that runs outside a transaction: with TypeORM, set transaction = false on the migration and migrationsTransactionMode: "each" in the DataSource.
